remarks: *** Highest and Best deadline is Tuesday 1/28 at 5pm *** This charming 1950s Cape Cod home offers the perfect balance of classic character and modern updates in a sought-after Rowayton school district. With 1,344 square feet of living space, 3 bedrooms, and 2 full baths, this home is as versatile as it is inviting. The heart of the home is the updated kitchen, featuring granite countertops, custom cabinetry, recessed lighting, and stainless steel appliances. It opens effortlessly to the cozy living room, where a wood-burning fireplace sets the stage for warm, relaxing evenings. From the kitchen, step into the private screened-in porch-a peaceful retreat for morning coffee, evening relaxation, or entertaining guests. The main level includes a flexible bedroom that can double as an office or den. Upstairs, two spacious bedrooms bathe in natural light and provide ample storage. The finished lower level adds even more possibilities with space for a family room, guest suite, or home office, along with additional storage and laundry facilities. Outside, recent updates enhance the home's curb appeal, including new siding, gutters, stonework, and railings. The small, fenced yard is perfect for pets or gardening, and the under-house garage offers convenience and practicality. Located in the Rowayton School District, just minutes from the train station, shopping, and major highways, this home combines timeless charm with modern amenities in an unbeatable location.
